name: Brake Lines, Hoses & Fittings
description: Rigid lines from the master cylinder(s) through the ABS (if fitted) to each corner, then flexible hoses across the suspension to the calipers. Factory: 3/16 in (4.76 mm) coated steel tube with metric ISO bubble flares, rubber flex hoses with banjo fittings. Race: same-size tube (steel or Cunifer) with -3 AN 37° ends or retained metric ends plus PTFE stainless-braided -3 hoses.

components.name: Master cylinder outlet lines (to ABS / bulkhead)
components.description: Short rigid (factory) or -3 AN hose/hard-line (race) runs from each master outlet to the ABS inlets or, without ABS, to the front tee and rear trunk line.
components.location: Factory: engine bay from tandem MC to BPMV. Race: footwell from masters across to ABS unit.

factory.name: GM pre-formed brake pipes, MC to BPMV
factory.notes: 3/16 in coated steel with ISO bubble flares.

raceOptions.name: -3 AN PTFE stainless hose with steel ends

hardware.torque: ≈ 110–130 in-lb (12–15 N·m) for steel -3 AN on 37° flare; ≈ 75–95 in-lb (8.5–11 N·m) for aluminum fittings

installNotes: Factory: install with BPMV, bend clear of the booster. Race: route in the footwell under a cover so the driver's feet cannot kick it.
inspection: Check for weeps at each fitting at every bleed.

modelRef.dimensions: 3/16 in lines, master outlets -> ABS inlet ports

components.name: Front hard lines (ABS → LF / RF flex-hose brackets)
components.description: Rigid lines from the ABS outlets (or front tee) to the body-mounted flex-hose brackets in each front wheel well. On a race car run them through a firewall bulkhead, along the frame rails, clipped every 300 mm, away from headers.
components.location: Engine bay along the frame rails to the inner wheel well brackets at x≈0.08, y≈0.47, z≈±0.58.

raceOptions.name: 3/16 in Cunifer (copper-nickel) tube with 37° flares and -3 AN tube nuts/sleeves
raceOptions.notes: Cunifer bends/flare easily and resists corrosion; DOT 3/16 steel also fine.

raceOptions.name: Retain metric bubble flare: 3/16 tube + M10x1 nuts and M10x1-to-AN3 adaptors at the hose bracket

hardware.torque: ≈ 110–130 in-lb (12–15 N·m) for steel -3 AN on 37° flare; ≈ 75–95 in-lb (8.5–11 N·m) for aluminum fittings

installNotes: Bend with a proper tube bender; leave a small service loop near the ABS for vibration.
Keep ≥ 150 mm from headers or wrap/shield; keep away from sharp edges and steering shaft.
Pressure test before bleeding: pedal held hard 60 s with no drop.
inspection: Check clips and look for rubbing where lines pass suspension/subframe.

modelRef.dimensions: 3/16 in (4.76 mm) line, ABS outlets -> body hose brackets
modelRef.features: Copper-nickel / coated steel line with tube nuts

components.name: Rear hard line(s) (ABS → rear axle)
components.description: Long run from the ABS/rear master to the rear subframe. Factory four-channel ABS uses two separate full-length lines (LR and RR) under the floor; a race car with rear-axle-only ABS control or no ABS can use one line to a rear tee. Run inside the cabin along the tunnel or underfloor tight to the floor inside the rocker line, protected from debris.
components.location: Under floor / inside cabin from x≈0.9 to the rear tee at x≈2.55.

factory.name: GM rear brake pipes (LR and RR separate)

raceOptions.name: Single 3/16 in Cunifer line with -3 AN ends

hardware.torque: Metric: 13 ft-lb (18 N·m); -3 AN: ≈ 110–130 in-lb (12–15 N·m) for steel -3 AN on 37° flare; ≈ 75–95 in-lb (8.5–11 N·m) for aluminum fittings

installNotes: Install during phase 2 while the floor is accessible; clip every ~300 mm with rubber-lined clips.
inspection: After off-track excursions check the underfloor line for dents/kinks.

sources.title: TightTorque – Chevrolet Camaro 6 (2016–2024) torque table, compiled from GM 2016–2018 Camaro service manual sections

modelRef.dimensions: 3/16 in line along the floor to the rear tee
modelRef.features: Clipped to the floor, tube nuts both ends

components.name: Rear brake tee / distribution block
components.description: Splits the single rear feed to LR and RR lines on the rear subframe/body (race single-line layout). Not used with the factory 4-channel system.
components.location: Rear subframe crossmember or body above it, x≈2.55, y≈0.33, z≈0.

raceOptions.name: -3 AN billet tee with mounting hole

hardware.torque: ≈ 110–130 in-lb (12–15 N·m) for steel -3 AN on 37° flare; ≈ 75–95 in-lb (8.5–11 N·m) for aluminum fittings

installNotes: Mount on the body (sprung side) so lines to each side only flex in the hoses.

components.name: Rear tee-to-corner hard lines (LR / RR)
components.description: Short rigid lines from the rear tee (or from the factory long lines) to the rear flex-hose brackets.
components.location: Rear subframe area to each rear wheel well bracket at x≈2.70, z≈±0.60.

hardware.torque: Metric: 13 ft-lb (18 N·m); -3 AN: ≈ 110–130 in-lb (12–15 N·m) for steel -3 AN on 37° flare; ≈ 75–95 in-lb (8.5–11 N·m) for aluminum fittings

installNotes: Route clear of the toe/camber links through full travel.

components.name: Front flexible brake hoses
components.description: Flex hose from the body bracket to the caliper inlet, allowing steering and suspension travel. Factory rubber hose with banjo at the caliper; race PTFE stainless-braided -3 hose (with abrasion cover) gives lower expansion and survives heat better.
components.location: Front wheel well: body bracket (x≈0.08, y≈0.47, z≈±0.58) to caliper inlet on the trailing caliper.

factory.name: GM front brake hose assembly (ZL1/1LE)
factory.notes: Banjo to caliper, tube nut + clip at the body bracket.

raceOptions.name: Goodridge G-Stop stainless PTFE brake line kit (Gen 6 Camaro)
raceOptions.notes: DOT-compliant kits exist for Gen 6; confirm length with race calipers.

raceOptions.name: Spiegler stainless lines (supplied in Essex/AP kits)

specs.Length: Check at full lock + full bump/droop with ≥ 25 mm slack, no twist

hardware.item: Front brake hose fitting bolt (banjo) at caliper
hardware.spec: M10x1.0 banjo bolt (typ. GM) with 2 copper crush washers
hardware.reuse: Bolt reusable; washers replace each removal
hardware.notes: GM table "Front brake hose fitting bolt" 40 N·m; Gen 5 ZL1 kit instructions also list hose-to-caliper 40 N·m.

hardware.item: Hose-to-hard-line tube nut at body bracket
hardware.notes: GM "Brake pipe fitting" 18 N·m; a Gen 5 ZL1 kit listed 16 N·m for hose-to-pipe.

installNotes: Fit after caliper is mounted; hang caliper on wire, never on the hose.
Steer lock-to-lock with suspension compressed and drooped; hose must not touch tire, wheel, strut or ABS wiring.
inspection: Inspect for chafing, kinks and heat damage every event; replace race hoses every 2–3 seasons.

components.name: Banjo bolts & copper crush washers
components.description: Banjo bolt and two soft copper sealing washers at each caliper inlet. Washers are single-use; a reused washer is the #1 cause of a weeping caliper inlet.

raceOptions.name: Race calipers often use 3/8-24 or M10x1 inverted-flare/AN inlet adaptors instead of banjos
raceOptions.notes: Use the caliper maker's seat type and washers.

installNotes: Clean seats, fit new washers both sides of banjo, torque.
inspection: Check for weeping after first session.

components.name: Firewall / floor bulkhead fittings (race)
components.description: -3 AN bulkhead unions where race lines pass through the firewall or floor, so lines can be serviced and the pass-through stays sealed (required firewall integrity for fire protection in most rulebooks).
components.location: Driver/passenger footwell firewall (x≈0.62–0.66) and floor exit for the rear line.

factory.name: n/a (factory lines are outside the cabin)

raceOptions.name: -3 AN bulkhead union with jam nut

hardware.torque: ≈ 110–130 in-lb (12–15 N·m) for steel -3 AN on 37° flare; ≈ 75–95 in-lb (8.5–11 N·m) for aluminum fittings

installNotes: Drill and deburr holes during chassis prep; seal around bulkheads with firewall sealant.

components.name: Metric-to-AN adaptors & tube nuts
components.description: Adaptors joining metric GM ports (M10x1 / M12x1 bubble) to -3 AN race plumbing, plus spare tube nuts and sleeves.
components.location: At ABS ports, MC ports, hose brackets as required.

raceOptions.name: M10x1.0 bubble-flare to -3 AN male adaptor
raceOptions.notes: Match seat type (ISO bubble vs. double/inverted flare) exactly.

hardware.torque: Metric side 13 ft-lb (18 N·m); AN side ≈ 110–130 in-lb (12–15 N·m) for steel -3 AN on 37° flare; ≈ 75–95 in-lb (8.5–11 N·m) for aluminum fittings

installNotes: Never mix 37° AN and 45° SAE flares.

components.name: Brake line clips, P-clamps & grommets
components.description: Rubber-lined P-clamps or push-in plastic clips every ~300 mm to stop vibration fatigue, plus grommets where lines pass through panels.

factory.name: GM plastic multi-line clips / push pins

raceOptions.name: Adel / rubber-cushioned P-clamps (3/16 in)
raceOptions.notes: Use rivnuts in the floor for serviceability.

installNotes: Install rivnuts before paint; fit clamps as lines are bent.
